messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PAGER-8231 fired for hosted-infer (region: west2a). Reason: sustained GPU memory pressure -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY on pool gpu-infer-pool-7. Sample log below.

pagerduty: Page fired: urgent oncall required. Escalation policy: gpu-infra.

Alex: ack — I'm on it, pulling logs & metrics now.

Alex: logs show repeated allocator failures and kernel OOMs: 
```
ERROR: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
E allocator.cpp: failed to allocate 512MB on device 0
E model_runner.cpp: KV cache alloc failed, attempt=3
E kernel.cu: launch failed with 1
```

Chen: seeing a KV-cache prefetch spike and high eviction churn on that pool ~5m before OOMs. Miss rate +15%.

Maria: customer impact -- hosted-api 5xx on /v1/chat rose from 0.2% -> 3.4% in the last 5m. A handful of low-latency customers retried.

Alex: mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback to smaller model for non-SLA tenants, 2) scale pool +2 GPUs, 3) drain the noisy node for repro. Executing fallback now: 
```bash
redwood route update --route "/v1/generate" --fallback-model rwd-small-3b --selector "tier!=enterprise"
```

oncall-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged by Alex.

Alex: scaling pool and cordoning node-7b: 
```bash
kubectl scale deployment gpu-infer-pool-7 --replicas=9 -n infer
kubectl cordon node-7b && kubectl drain node-7b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n infer
```

Chen: rolled a short canary that disables KV prefetch for one replica to see effect. Canary ID: canary-8231.

Maria: notifying support/success to pre-emptively message impacted tenants and open PD incident note. Template: "We're investigating GPU memory OOMs affecting some requests; we've applied fallbacks & scaling."

Alex: after scale + fallback + canary, OOM event rate dropped ~80%, error rate down to 0.6% (still above baseline). Continuing to monitor for 30m.

Alex: handoff summary for Maria: suspected root cause = KV-cache aggressive prefetch + fragmentation leading to allocator failures under burst. Mitigations applied = scale +2 GPUs, enabled fallback-small for non-SLA traffic, drained node-7b, deployed canary disabling prefetch. Links: logs https://redwood.internal/logs/8555554321 , PD https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PAGER-8231 .

Maria: ack, taking over monitoring and PD notes. Will escalate to infra if OOMs reappear and follow up with a postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:

Chen: I'll follow up with a lightweight repro and a patch proposal to limit prefetch concurrency.

Alex: thanks - leaving the PD note and a short Ops checklist in the incident.

pagerduty: incident PAGER-8231 status: acknowledged -> monitoring.
